claim_type: application/corollary of a published proper-branched-cover theorem
limitations: Topological corollary only. It assumes a proper continuous open discrete map; it does not prove openness/discreteness for every analytic quasiregular map on the step-3 Cartan group.
provenance: Corrected by independent audit on 2026-09-29. Originality claim withdrawn because Kauranen-Luisto-Tengvall Proposition 4.3 directly yields the result for R^5.
record_title: Cartan-group corollary of the compact-branch proper-covering theorem
